description: Option codes whose meaning is only in the visible option text.

source.content: <form><label for="c">Client</label><input id="c" name="client" required><label for="m">Matter</label><select id="m" name="matter_code" required><option value="F1">Family matters</option><option value="W2">Work dispute</option><option value="R3">Buying or selling a home</option></select></form>
